_README: Recorded Sterling response used for offline integration testing.

_provenance.whyThisOne: This is the ONLY product record in any repository that is a genuine recorded response from Sterling rather than an authored sample. The authored NAMETAG/DESKPLATE fixtures in newOldDesigner are NOT real (they use a STRING designerVariationCode where the real response uses INTEGER 3), and the DEMO-/TEST- catalogues are fictional by construction.
_provenance.fieldsOmitted: Colour arrays, product options, image paths and translated descriptions were dropped — they are not needed by the Product contract.
_provenance.fieldsKeptDeliberately: LOWESTPRICE and VARIATIONS are retained ONLY so a test can prove the normalizer DISCARDS commercial data. They must never appear in a normalized Product record.
_provenance.snapshotAge: OLDER SNAPSHOT. Genuine recorded response, but captured before changes now present in oldDesigner/functions.cfc::getStampInfo() (repo HEAD 4acebee, last commit 2026-08-19). Current production code returns SEVEN keys this recording does not contain: BANDSTRING, DESCRIPTIONFR, PRODUCTOPTIONS, SAMPLEIMAGEEN, SAMPLEIMAGEFR, PRODUCTIMAGEEN, PRODUCTIMAGEFR. No value for any of them has been invented here — the recording is left exactly as captured.
_provenance.snapshotAgeImpact: None of the seven additions affect the normalized Product fields currently consumed. Every field the contract reads — WIDTH, HEIGHT, CANVASWIDTH, CANVASHEIGHT, BLEED*, MARGIN*, BORDER*, MINPAGES, MAXPAGES, MAXLINES, SHAPE, DISPLAYUNIT, DESIGNERVARIATIONCODE, PRODUCTIDINT, PARTNUMBER, DESCRIPTION, ISPROSTAMP, GREENINKAVAILABLE, DATERBOX*, CLIPPATHS, CLIPPATHOVERLAYS — is unchanged in current source. DESCRIPTIONFR, PRODUCTOPTIONS and the four image-path keys are DISCARDED by normalizeStampInfo(); BANDSTRING is an already-declared contract field (legacy.bandString) and is consumed when present. Proven offline by scripts/test-product-provider.mjs checks L1-L4, which replay this recording with those keys added using SYNTHETIC values purely to prove they are ignored.
_provenance.verifiedAgainstSource: oldDesigner/functions.cfc:98 is the canonical live implementation. portals/Web/site/services/ProductService.cfc is unwired dead code and is NOT the source of this shape. Canvas derivation confirmed at functions.cfc:528-535: int(widthIn * 96) / int(widthMM * 3.779527559).
_provenance.doNotEdit: Treat these values as recorded evidence. Do not adjust them to make a test pass, and do not add invented products beside them.
